title: Spore Cluster Colony
description: The tunnel opens into a chamber carpeted with bioluminescent spore clusters. Pulsing green and violet light radiates from the largest formations, casting eerie shadows. The spores drift lazily in the still air — beautiful but potentially reactive. Disturbing them could release a concentrated burst.

choices.label: Careful extraction
choices.description: Gently harvest individual spore clusters with patience.

choices.label: Disturb the colony
choices.description: Shake the clusters loose for a bigger haul. The spore burst will sting.

choices.label: Admire and move on
choices.description: The bioluminescence is mesmerizing. You leave it undisturbed.
